def solve(clue):
    P = clue.split("\n")
    T = P.pop()                                   # the "<n> fall" line, copied through
    B = P.pop()                                   # the shelf
    W = len(B)
    P = [x.ljust(W) for x in P]
    L = P[-1]                                     # bottom row of the picture = the layout
    M = len(P)
    H = [M - 1 - len(z) + len(z.lstrip()) for z in map("".join, zip(*P))]
    g = lambda j: 0 <= j < W and L[j] == "."
    Q = [[" "] * W for _ in range(M)]
    Q[M - 1] = list(L)
    for i in range(W):
        h = H[i]
        if not h:
            continue
        d = g(i + 1) - g(i - 1)                   # +1 gap on the right only, -1 on the left only
        b = 1 if d and 0 <= i + 2 * d < W and H[i + 2 * d] > h else 0
        j = i + b * d                             # a falling book's body moves into the gap
        for t in range(1, h):
            Q[M - 1 - t][j] = L[i]
        Q[M - 1 - h][j] = "_/\\"[b * d]
    return "\n".join("".join(x).rstrip() for x in Q) + "\n" + B + "\n" + T
